example.title: Create, read, and delete an in-memory greeting
description: Each example is a separate project. All required application files appear in the tabs.
The map is an in-memory store for this example. Restarting the application clears it.
The commands run in order after a fresh start so the created ID is `1`.
Request validation is added in the next lesson. This example sends a valid name.
`mvn spring-boot:run` starts the application from the directory containing `pom.xml`. Requests run in a second terminal.
explanation: The `POST` stores the response DTO and returns `201` with `Location: /greetings/1`.
The first `GET` returns `200` and the stored DTO.
The final `GET` returns `404` because the map no longer contains ID `1`.
`ResponseEntity<Void>` declares that the delete response has no body.
The map keeps this example focused on responses. Database-backed repositories are introduced in the data lessons.
example.commands:
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/greetings \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Ada"}'
curl -i http://localhost:8080/greetings/1
curl -i -X DELETE http://localhost:8080/greetings/1
curl -i http://localhost:8080/greetings/1
